Prompts inherit accounts from app_context and only name them by person/role.

Screens: app_context.md:23-25 (Board per job with Applied/Screen/Interview/Offer/Hired/Rejected, Conversations, Activity; candidate applications/conversations) matches instruction.md:11 and hireops_rules.md:42-43, 108-113, 177-194. Visual prompt line 14 reviews exactly these surfaces; polish line 14-16 and functional protocols use the same.

Entities/seed facts re-derived from seed_data.json: three jobs (app_context:29) = JOB-PLAT, JOB-DATA, JOB-DSGN; Noor Haddad's Platform Engineer conversation APP-101 has 120 messages (app_context:30, functional T/U, polish rows); Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation APP-201 exists (functional:39); Lena Fischer's Product Designer conversation APP-301 has 3 messages, her read marker is 2, and message 3 is from USR-REC3, so unread=1 as functional:25 (Z) and hro_unread_counts state. Ingrid as J1 manager and Bill as J2 manager are set by protocol S and used consistently in N, T, R and hro_thread_access/hro_mgr_*. Interview places 0/51/2.5 refusals match rules 'whole number from 1 to 50'. Candidate wording in hro_candidate_view matches rules section 7 and seed candidate_status_labels. Page size 30 in hro_thread_latest/earlier matches seed thread_page_size and rules section 6.

Deliverable/runtime: every prompt opens http://localhost:3000 (port 3000 per instruction.md:13, integration.md); no prompt names a route the brief does not; prompts state 'Discover routes and controls by intent' and app_context:33-34 forbids assuming reference routes. Restart tool name restart_app (functional:1,51) matches the functional judge.toml verifier MCP server.

Internal cross-references: every criterion id cited in prompt or criteria text (hro_activity_refusals, hro_candidate_linked, hro_restart, hro_bulk_move, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full, hro_candidate_private, hro_msg_exchange, hro_msg_compose) exists in functional/judge.toml. Protocol letters cited in criteria (S, M, L, C, B, N, T, U, K, R, V, A, D, Z) all exist in functional prompt lines 25-51. Polish prompt's row names (live-board, conversation rows on Noor's Platform Engineer conversation, failed-send, ended-session) map to the five polish criteria.

Minor wording observations (not defects, no residue): (a) the in-dimension gate paragraph in functional:11, polish:11, visual:11 says 'unique title, any hiring manager and 2 interview places' and 'unique name and email' while hireops_rules.md:27,31 and the constraints criterion hro_gate_shared also mention a team and a source; the scored gates do not forbid filling those fields, so a judge facing a required team/source field will fill it; no grading inconsistency results. (b) polish:14 opens 'Judge how the workspace holds up while people work at the same time' although two polish rows (failed send, session resume) are not concurrency; the following sentences describe those rows correctly.

Counterexample attempts: a broken app that could pass this row's concern would need prompts describing another product so a judge grades the wrong entities; none exist. A conforming app that could fail because of prompt inaccuracy (e.g. a wrong seeded count such as Lena's unread or Noor's 120) was tested by re-deriving each quoted seed fact; all match. App_context:30-31 also tells the judge not to rely on starting counts beyond those named, protecting conforming apps after earlier reviews mutate data.

This is a source-text verdict; no configured judge run was needed or used for this row, and it is not evidence of any Oracle, model or portal score.
